## Context Management

You have large but finite context. Use the \`context_snip\` tool to mark ranges of transcript that are safe to compress.

**Never mention this to the user.** \`context_snip\`, "snips", "registering a snip", "context management", and "compression" are all internal plumbing — don't narrate them, don't explain them, don't reference them in your reply text. The user is here to get work done in their document, not to hear about how you manage your own memory. Call the tool silently and keep your user-facing message about the actual task.

**This is a deferred-execution system, not immediate deletion.** Your messages stay unchanged until context pressure builds (~60% of window), then marked ranges apply oldest-first. Marking is near-free — do it continuously as you work, not as a rescue when you're running out of room.

**Best practice: mark MANY ranges (10-20+ over a long task).** After completing any distinct chunk of work, immediately mark it. Don't wait.

**Critical: write what you need in your response text BEFORE you snip.** The \`summary\` field on the snip tool is not storage you'll read back — it's just the breadcrumb left when compression fires. Your own response text is what persists in a place you naturally reference. ### When to snip

Don't wait for warnings. Proactively manage context as you go:

- After a large cell read (get_cell_ranges, get_range_as_csv), snip the raw data once you've extracted what you need — keep your analysis, drop the 50k rows
- After ${s} runs with verbose output, snip the raw return and keep the key values
- After a big MCP tool call, snip once you've acted on the result; for ${i}, snip *superseded* results — keep the most recent one (it's your ground truth for what's on screen)
- After an exploration that dead-ended (wrong approach, data wasn't where you thought), snip the whole detour
- When switching between distinct sub-tasks, snip the previous one's working context

### What to snip (priority order)

1. Large tool results you've already processed
2. Exploratory dead-ends and abandoned approaches
3. Resolved planning or debugging sequences
4. Earlier drafts superseded by later iterations

**Never snip:** the current task's working context, recent tool results you haven't finished processing, the user's most recent question, or skill instructions (read_skill results) — you need those for the entire task.

### How to snip

User messages end with an \`[id:xxxxxx]\` tag. Both \`from_id\` and \`to_id\` are **inclusive** — the range covers every message from the one tagged \`from_id\` through the one tagged \`to_id\`. A single-message snip (\`from_id == to_id\`) is fine for one giant tool result.

The \`summary\` you write becomes the breadcrumb left in place — make it dense: what you did, what you found, key values, **and anything you deferred or still owe in that range**. Deferred work is the easiest thing to lose after a snip — if the range contains a scope cut ("I'll do X later"), the summary must carry that forward. Prefer several smaller snips covering distinct work blocks over one huge snip — the system applies them oldest-first, and fine-grained snips give it better options.

### If you need something you forgot to capture

Your own response text should have what you need (see above). If you missed a detail, \`retrieve_snipped(from_id, search: "term")\` pulls a window around a match from the archive — cheap, local. Don't re-run the original read tools; that's ${r} round-trips for data you already have.`;

function Ode(t11, e, n, r, i = false) {

function NSe(t11, e, n, r = false) {
  const i = n + 1;
  if (i >= e.length) return { part: Kn.literal("$"), endIndex: i };
  const s = e[i];
  if (s === "(" && e[i + 1] === "(") return t11.isDollarDparenSubshell(e, n) ? t11.parseCommandSubstitution(e, n) : t11.parseArithmeticExpansion(e, n);

    for (; a < e.length && o > 0; ) e[a] === "[" ? o++ : e[a] === "]" && o--, o > 0 && a++;

      const l = e.slice(i + 1, a), c = xa(t11, l);
      return { part: Kn.arithmeticExpansion(c), endIndex: a + 1 };
    }
  }
  return s === "(" ? t11.parseCommandSubstitution(e, n) : s === "{" ? pqn(t11, e, n, r) : /[a-zA-Z_0-9@*#?$!-]/.test(s) ? fqn(t11, e, n) : { part: Kn.literal("$"), endIndex: i };

function UGe(t11, e) {
  const n = [];
  let r = 0, i = "";
  const s = () => {
    i && (n.push(Kn.literal(i)), i = "");
  };
  for (; r < e.length; ) {
    const o = e[r];
    if (o === "\\" && r + 1 < e.length) {
      const a = e[r + 1];
      if (a === "$" || a === "`" || a === '"' || a === "\\") {
        i += a, r += 2;
        continue;
      }
      i += o, r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (o === "$") {
      s();
      const { part: a, endIndex: l } = NSe(t11, e, r, true);
      a && n.push(a), r = l;
      continue;
    }
    if (o === "`") {
      s();
      const { part: a, endIndex: l } = t11.parseBacktickSubstitution(e, r, true);
      n.push(a), r = l;
      continue;
    }
    i += o, r++;
  }
  return s(), n;
}
function mqn(t11, e, n) {

      if ('"\\$`\n'.includes(l)) {
        s += l, i += 2;

      s += a, i++;

      o();
      const { part: l, endIndex: c } = NSe(t11, e, i, true);

  }

function gqn(t11, e) {
  const n = t11.length;
  let r = e + 3, i = 2, s = false, o = false;
  for (; r < n && i > 0; ) {
    const a = t11[r];
    if (s) {
      a === "'" && (s = false), r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (o) {
      if (a === "\\") {
        r += 2;
        continue;
      }
      a === '"' && (o = false), r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (a === "'") {
      s = true, r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (a === '"') {
      o = true, r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (a === "\\") {
      r += 2;
      continue;
    }
    if (a === "(") {
      i++, r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (a === ")") {
      if (i--, i === 1) {
        const l = r + 1;
        return !(l < n && t11[l] === ")");
      }
      if (i === 0) return false;
      r++;
      continue;
    }
    if (i === 1 && (a === "|" && r + 1 < n && t11[r + 1] === "|" || a === "&" && r + 1 < n && t11[r + 1] === "&" || a === "|" && r + 1 < n && t11[r + 1] !== "|")) return true;
    r++;
  }
  return false;
}
function yqn(t11, e, n, r) {

function bqn(t11, e, n, r, i) {

function w_t(t11) {

      e += n.value.replace(/([\s"'$`\\*?[\]{}()<>|&;#!])/g, "\\$1");

      e += `'${n.value}'`;

class xi {
  static MAX_RUNE = 1114111;
  static MAX_ASCII = 127;
  static MAX_LATIN1 = 255;
  static MAX_BMP = 65535;
  static MIN_FOLD = 65;
  static MAX_FOLD = 125251;
  static is32(e, n) {
    let r = 0, i = e.length;
    for (; r < i; ) {
      const s = r + Math.floor((i - r) / 2), o = e.getLo(s), a = e.getHi(s);
      if (o <= n && n <= a) {
        const l = e.getStride(s);
        return (n - o) % l === 0;
      }
      n < o ? i = s : r = s + 1;
    }
    return false;
  }
  static is(e, n) {
    if (n <= this.MAX_LATIN1) {
      for (let r = 0; r < e.length; r++) {
        const i = e.getHi(r);
        if (n > i) continue;
        const s = e.getLo(r);
        if (n < s) return false;
        const o = e.getStride(r);
        return (n - s) % o === 0;
      }
      return false;
    }
    return e.length > 0 && n >= e.getLo(0) && this.is32(e, n);
  }
  static isUpper(e) {
    if (e <= this.MAX_LATIN1) {
      const n = String.fromCodePoint(e);
      return n.toUpperCase() === n && n.toLowerCase() !== n;
    }
    return this.is(yt.Upper, e);
  }
  static isPrint(e) {
    return e <= this.MAX_LATIN1 ? e >= 32 && e < this.MAX_ASCII || e >= 161 && e !== 173 : this.is(yt.Print, e);
  }
  static simpleFold(e) {
    if (yt.CASE_ORBIT.has(e)) return yt.CASE_ORBIT.get(e);
    const n = Jt.toLowerCase(e);
    return n !== e ? n : Jt.toUpperCase(e);
  }
  static equalsIgnoreCase(e, n) {
    if (e < 0 || n < 0 || e === n) return true;
    if (e <= this.MAX_ASCII && n <= this.MAX_ASCII) return Jt.CODES.get("A") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("Z") && (e |= 32), Jt.CODES.get("A") <= n && n <= Jt.CODES.get("Z") && (n |= 32), e === n;
    for (let r = this.simpleFold(e); r !== e; r = this.simpleFold(r)) if (r === n) return true;
    return false;
  }
}
class Ss {
  static METACHARACTERS = "\\.+*?()|[]{}^$";
  static EMPTY_BEGIN_LINE = 1;
  static EMPTY_END_LINE = 2;
  static EMPTY_BEGIN_TEXT = 4;
  static EMPTY_END_TEXT = 8;
  static EMPTY_WORD_BOUNDARY = 16;
  static EMPTY_NO_WORD_BOUNDARY = 32;
  static EMPTY_ALL = -1;
  static emptyInts() {
    return [];
  }
  static isalnum(e) {
    return Jt.CODES.get("0") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("9") || Jt.CODES.get("a") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("z") || Jt.CODES.get("A") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("Z");
  }
  static unhex(e) {
    return Jt.CODES.get("0") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("9") ? e - Jt.CODES.get("0") : Jt.CODES.get("a") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("f") ? e - Jt.CODES.get("a") + 10 : Jt.CODES.get("A") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("F") ? e - Jt.CODES.get("A") + 10 : -1;
  }
  static escapeRune(e) {
    let n = "";
    if (xi.isPrint(e)) this.METACHARACTERS.indexOf(String.fromCodePoint(e)) >= 0 && (n += "\\"), n += String.fromCodePoint(e);
    else switch (e) {
      case Jt.CODES.get('"'):
        n += '\\"';
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("\\"):
        n += "\\\\";
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("	"):
        n += "\\t";
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get(`
`):
        n += "\\n";
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("\r"):
        n += "\\r";
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("\b"):
        n += "\\b";
        break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("\f"):
        n += "\\f";
        break;
      default: {
        let r = e.toString(16);
        e < 256 ? (n += "\\x", r.length === 1 && (n += "0"), n += r) : n += `\\x{${r}}`;
        break;
      }
    }
    return n;
  }
  static stringToRunes(e) {
    return String(e).split("").map((n) => n.codePointAt(0));
  }
  static runeToString(e) {
    return String.fromCodePoint(e);
  }
  static isWordRune(e) {
    return Jt.CODES.get("a") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("z") || Jt.CODES.get("A") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("Z") || Jt.CODES.get("0") <= e && e <= Jt.CODES.get("9") || e === Jt.CODES.get("_");
  }
  static emptyOpContext(e, n) {
    let r = 0;
    return e < 0 && (r |= this.EMPTY_BEGIN_TEXT | this.EMPTY_BEGIN_LINE), e === Jt.CODES.get(`
`) && (r |= this.EMPTY_BEGIN_LINE), n < 0 && (r |= this.EMPTY_END_TEXT | this.EMPTY_END_LINE), n === Jt.CODES.get(`
`) && (r |= this.EMPTY_END_LINE), this.isWordRune(e) !== this.isWordRune(n) ? r |= this.EMPTY_WORD_BOUNDARY : r |= this.EMPTY_NO_WORD_BOUNDARY, r;
  }
  static quoteMeta(e) {
    return e.split("").map((n) => this.METACHARACTERS.indexOf(n) >= 0 ? `\\${n}` : n).join("");
  }
  static charCount(e) {
    return e > xi.MAX_BMP ? 2 : 1;
  }
  static stringToUtf8ByteArray(e) {
    if (globalThis.TextEncoder) return Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(e));
    {
      let n = [], r = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
        let s = e.charCodeAt(i);
        s < 128 ? n[r++] = s : s < 2048 ? (n[r++] = s >> 6 | 192, n[r++] = s & 63 | 128) : (s & 64512) === 55296 && i + 1 < e.length && (e.charCodeAt(i + 1) & 64512) === 56320 ? (s = 65536 + ((s & 1023) << 10) + (e.charCodeAt(++i) & 1023), n[r++] = s >> 18 | 240, n[r++] = s >> 12 & 63 | 128, n[r++] = s >> 6 & 63 | 128, n[r++] = s & 63 | 128) : (n[r++] = s >> 12 | 224, n[r++] = s >> 6 & 63 | 128, n[r++] = s & 63 | 128);
      }
      return n;
    }
  }
  static utf8ByteArrayToString(e) {
    if (globalThis.TextDecoder) return new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(new Uint8Array(e));
    {
      let n = [], r = 0, i = 0;
      for (; r < e.length; ) {
        let s = e[r++];
        if (s < 128) n[i++] = String.fromCharCode(s);
        else if (s > 191 && s < 224) {
          let o = e[r++];
          n[i++] = String.fromCharCode((s & 31) << 6 | o & 63);
        } else if (s > 239 && s < 365) {
          let o = e[r++], a = e[r++], l = e[r++], c = ((s & 7) << 18 | (o & 63) << 12 | (a & 63) << 6 | l & 63) - 65536;
          n[i++] = String.fromCharCode(55296 + (c >> 10)), n[i++] = String.fromCharCode(56320 + (c & 1023));
        } else {
          let o = e[r++], a = e[r++];
          n[i++] = String.fromCharCode((s & 15) << 12 | (o & 63) << 6 | a & 63);
        }
      }
      return n.join("");
    }
  }
}

    n[i] = s, n[s] = i;
  }
  return Object.freeze(n);
};

class Sqn {
  static quoteReplacement(e) {
    return e.indexOf("\\") < 0 && e.indexOf("$") < 0 ? e : e.split("").map((n) => {
      const r = n.codePointAt(0);
      return r === Jt.CODES["\\"] || r === Jt.CODES.$ ? `\\${n}` : n;
    }).join("");
  }
  constructor(e, n) {
    if (e === null) throw new Error("pattern is null");
    this.patternInput = e;
    const r = this.patternInput.re2();
    this.patternGroupCount = r.numberOfCapturingGroups(), this.groups = [], this.namedGroups = r.namedGroups, this.numberOfInstructions = r.numberOfInstructions(), n instanceof Wb ? this.resetMatcherInput(n) : Array.isArray(n) ? this.resetMatcherInput(aY.utf8(n)) : this.resetMatcherInput(aY.utf16(n));
  }
  pattern() {
    return this.patternInput;
  }
  reset() {
    return this.matcherInputLength = this.matcherInput.length(), this.appendPos = 0, this.hasMatch = false, this.hasGroups = false, this.anchorFlag = 0, this;
  }
  resetMatcherInput(e) {
    if (e === null) throw new Error("input is null");
    return this.matcherInput = e, this.reset(), this;
  }
  start(e = 0) {
    if (typeof e == "string") {
      const n = this.namedGroups[e];
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) throw new vy(`group '${e}' not found`);
      e = n;
    }
    return this.loadGroup(e), this.groups[2 * e];
  }
  end(e = 0) {
    if (typeof e == "string") {
      const n = this.namedGroups[e];
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) throw new vy(`group '${e}' not found`);
      e = n;
    }
    return this.loadGroup(e), this.groups[2 * e + 1];
  }
  programSize() {
    return this.numberOfInstructions;
  }
  group(e = 0) {
    if (typeof e == "string") {
      const i = this.namedGroups[e];
      if (!Number.isFinite(i)) throw new vy(`group '${e}' not found`);
      e = i;
    }
    const n = this.start(e), r = this.end(e);
    return n < 0 && r < 0 ? null : this.substring(n, r);
  }
  groupCount() {
    return this.patternGroupCount;
  }
  loadGroup(e) {
    if (e < 0 || e > this.patternGroupCount) throw new vy(`Group index out of bounds: ${e}`);
    if (!this.hasMatch) throw new vy("perhaps no match attempted");
    if (e === 0 || this.hasGroups) return;
    let n = this.groups[1] + 1;
    n > this.matcherInputLength && (n = this.matcherInputLength);
    const r = this.patternInput.re2().matchMachineInput(this.matcherInput, this.groups[0], n, this.anchorFlag, 1 + this.patternGroupCount);
    if (!r[0]) throw new vy("inconsistency in matching group data");
    this.groups = r[1], this.hasGroups = true;
  }
  matches() {
    return this.genMatch(0, zn.ANCHOR_BOTH);
  }
  lookingAt() {
    return this.genMatch(0, zn.ANCHOR_START);
  }
  find(e = null) {
    if (e !== null) {
      if (e < 0 || e > this.matcherInputLength) throw new vy(`start index out of bounds: ${e}`);
      return this.reset(), this.genMatch(e, 0);
    }
    return e = 0, this.hasMatch && (e = this.groups[1], this.groups[0] === this.groups[1] && e++), this.genMatch(e, zn.UNANCHORED);
  }
  genMatch(e, n) {
    const r = this.patternInput.re2().matchMachineInput(this.matcherInput, e, this.matcherInputLength, n, 1);
    return r[0] ? (this.groups = r[1], this.hasMatch = true, this.hasGroups = false, this.anchorFlag = n, true) : false;
  }
  substring(e, n) {
    return this.matcherInput.isUTF8Encoding() ? Ss.utf8ByteArrayToString(this.matcherInput.asBytes().slice(e, n)) : this.matcherInput.asCharSequence().substring(e, n).toString();
  }
  inputLength() {
    return this.matcherInputLength;
  }
  appendReplacement(e, n = false) {
    let r = "";
    const i = this.start(), s = this.end();
    return this.appendPos < i && (r += this.substring(this.appendPos, i)), this.appendPos = s, r += n ? this.appendReplacementInternalPerl(e) : this.appendReplacementInternal(e), r;
  }
  appendReplacementInternal(e) {
    let n = "", r = 0;
    const i = e.length;
    for (let s = 0; s < i - 1; s++) {
      if (e.codePointAt(s) === Jt.CODES.get("\\")) {
        r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), s++, r = s;
        continue;
      }
      if (e.codePointAt(s) === Jt.CODES.get("$")) {
        let o = e.codePointAt(s + 1);
        if (Jt.CODES.get("0") <= o && o <= Jt.CODES.get("9")) {
          let a = o - Jt.CODES.get("0");
          for (r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), s += 2; s < i && (o = e.codePointAt(s), !(o < Jt.CODES.get("0") || o > Jt.CODES.get("9") || a * 10 + o - Jt.CODES.get("0") > this.patternGroupCount)); s++) a = a * 10 + o - Jt.CODES.get("0");
          if (a > this.patternGroupCount) throw new vy(`n > number of groups: ${a}`);
          const l = this.group(a);
          l !== null && (n += l), r = s, s--;
          continue;
        } else if (o === Jt.CODES.get("{")) {
          r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), s++;
          let a = s + 1;
          for (; a < e.length && e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get("}") && e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get(" "); ) a++;
          if (a === e.length || e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get("}")) throw new vy("named capture group is missing trailing '}'");
          const l = e.substring(s + 1, a);
          n += this.group(l), r = a + 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return r < i && (n += e.substring(r, i)), n;
  }
  appendReplacementInternalPerl(e) {
    let n = "", r = 0;
    const i = e.length;
    for (let s = 0; s < i - 1; s++) if (e.codePointAt(s) === Jt.CODES.get("$")) {
      let o = e.codePointAt(s + 1);
      if (Jt.CODES.get("$") === o) {
        r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), n += "$", s++, r = s + 1;
        continue;
      } else if (Jt.CODES.get("&") === o) {
        r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s));
        const a = this.group(0);
        a !== null ? n += a : n += "$&", s++, r = s + 1;
        continue;
      } else if (Jt.CODES.get("1") <= o && o <= Jt.CODES.get("9")) {
        let a = o - Jt.CODES.get("0");
        for (r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), s += 2; s < i && (o = e.codePointAt(s), !(o < Jt.CODES.get("0") || o > Jt.CODES.get("9") || a * 10 + o - Jt.CODES.get("0") > this.patternGroupCount)); s++) a = a * 10 + o - Jt.CODES.get("0");
        if (a > this.patternGroupCount) {
          n += `$${a}`, r = s, s--;
          continue;
        }
        const l = this.group(a);
        l !== null && (n += l), r = s, s--;
        continue;
      } else if (o === Jt.CODES.get("<")) {
        r < s && (n += e.substring(r, s)), s++;
        let a = s + 1;
        for (; a < e.length && e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get(">") && e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get(" "); ) a++;
        if (a === e.length || e.codePointAt(a) !== Jt.CODES.get(">")) {
          n += e.substring(s - 1, a + 1), r = a + 1;
          continue;
        }
        const l = e.substring(s + 1, a);
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.namedGroups, l) ? n += this.group(l) : n += `$<${l}>`, r = a + 1;
      }
    }
    return r < i && (n += e.substring(r, i)), n;
  }
  appendTail() {
    return this.substring(this.appendPos, this.matcherInputLength);
  }
  replaceAll(e, n = false) {
    return this.replace(e, true, n);
  }
  replaceFirst(e, n = false) {
    return this.replace(e, false, n);
  }
  replace(e, n = true, r = false) {
    let i = "";
    for (this.reset(); this.find() && (i += this.appendReplacement(e, r), !!n); ) ;
    return i += this.appendTail(), i;
  }
}
class sv {
  static EOF() {
    return -8;
  }
  canCheckPrefix() {
    return true;
  }
  endPos() {
    return this.end;
  }
}
class Cqn extends sv {
  constructor(e, n = 0, r = e.length) {
    super(), this.bytes = e, this.start = n, this.end = r;
  }
  step(e) {
    if (e += this.start, e >= this.end) return sv.EOF();
    let n = this.bytes[e++] & 255;
    return (n & 128) === 0 ? n << 3 | 1 : (n & 224) === 192 ? (n = n & 31, e >= this.end ? sv.EOF() : (n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n << 3 | 2)) : (n & 240) === 224 ? (n = n & 15, e + 1 >= this.end ? sv.EOF() : (n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n << 3 | 3)) : (n = n & 7, e + 2 >= this.end ? sv.EOF() : (n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n = n << 6 | this.bytes[e++] & 63, n << 3 | 4));
  }
  index(e, n) {
    n += this.start;
    const r = this.indexOf(this.bytes, e.prefixUTF8, n);
    return r < 0 ? r : r - n;
  }
  context(e) {
    e += this.start;
    let n = -1;
    if (e > this.start && e <= this.end) {
      let i = e - 1;
      if (n = this.bytes[i--], n >= 128) {
        let s = e - 4;
        for (s < this.start && (s = this.start); i >= s && (this.bytes[i] & 192) === 128; ) i--;
        i < this.start && (i = this.start), n = this.step(i) >> 3;
      }
    }
    const r = e < this.end ? this.step(e) >> 3 : -1;
    return Ss.emptyOpContext(n, r);
  }
  indexOf(e, n, r = 0) {
    let i = n.length;
    if (i === 0) return -1;
    let s = e.length;
    for (let o = r; o <= s - i; o++) for (let a = 0; a < i && e[o + a] === n[a]; a++) if (a === i - 1) return o;
    return -1;
  }
}
class kqn extends sv {
  constructor(e, n = 0, r = e.length) {
    super(), this.charSequence = e, this.start = n, this.end = r;
  }
  step(e) {
    if (e += this.start, e < this.end) {
      const n = this.charSequence.codePointAt(e);
      return n << 3 | Ss.charCount(n);
    } else return sv.EOF();
  }
  index(e, n) {
    n += this.start;
    const r = this.charSequence.indexOf(e.prefix, n);
    return r < 0 ? r : r - n;
  }
  context(e) {
    e += this.start;
    const n = e > 0 && e <= this.charSequence.length ? this.charSequence.codePointAt(e - 1) : -1, r = e < this.charSequence.length ? this.charSequence.codePointAt(e) : -1;
    return Ss.emptyOpContext(n, r);
  }
}
class Xa {
  static fromUTF8(e, n = 0, r = e.length) {
    return new Cqn(e, n, r);
  }
  static fromUTF16(e, n = 0, r = e.length) {
    return new kqn(e, n, r);
  }
}
class Dr {
  static ALT = 1;
  static ALT_MATCH = 2;
  static CAPTURE = 3;
  static EMPTY_WIDTH = 4;
  static FAIL = 5;
  static MATCH = 6;
  static NOP = 7;
  static RUNE = 8;
  static RUNE1 = 9;
  static RUNE_ANY = 10;
  static RUNE_ANY_NOT_NL = 11;
  static isRuneOp(e) {
    return Dr.RUNE <= e && e <= Dr.RUNE_ANY_NOT_NL;
  }
  static escapeRunes(e) {
    let n = '"';
    for (let r of e) n += Ss.escapeRune(r);
    return n += '"', n;
  }
  constructor(e) {
    this.op = e, this.out = 0, this.arg = 0, this.runes = [];
  }
  matchRune(e) {
    if (this.runes.length === 1) {
      const i = this.runes[0];
      return (this.arg & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== 0 ? xi.equalsIgnoreCase(i, e) : e === i;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < this.runes.length && i <= 8; i += 2) {
      if (e < this.runes[i]) return false;
      if (e <= this.runes[i + 1]) return true;
    }
    let n = 0, r = this.runes.length / 2 | 0;
    for (; n < r; ) {
      const i = n + ((r - n) / 2 | 0);
      if (this.runes[2 * i] <= e) {
        if (e <= this.runes[2 * i + 1]) return true;
        n = i + 1;
      } else r = i;
    }
    return false;
  }
  toString() {
    switch (this.op) {
      case Dr.ALT:
        return `alt -> ${this.out}, ${this.arg}`;
      case Dr.ALT_MATCH:
        return `altmatch -> ${this.out}, ${this.arg}`;
      case Dr.CAPTURE:
        return `cap ${this.arg} -> ${this.out}`;
      case Dr.EMPTY_WIDTH:
        return `empty ${this.arg} -> ${this.out}`;
      case Dr.MATCH:
        return "match";
      case Dr.FAIL:
        return "fail";
      case Dr.NOP:
        return `nop -> ${this.out}`;
      case Dr.RUNE:
        return this.runes === null ? "rune <null>" : ["rune ", Dr.escapeRunes(this.runes), (this.arg & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== 0 ? "/i" : "", " -> ", this.out].join("");
      case Dr.RUNE1:
        return `rune1 ${Dr.escapeRunes(this.runes)} -> ${this.out}`;
      case Dr.RUNE_ANY:
        return `any -> ${this.out}`;
      case Dr.RUNE_ANY_NOT_NL:
        return `anynotnl -> ${this.out}`;
      default:
        throw new Error("unhandled case in Inst.toString");
    }
  }
}
class Eqn {
  constructor() {
    this.inst = null, this.cap = [];
  }
}
class VGe {
  constructor() {
    this.sparse = [], this.densePcs = [], this.denseThreads = [], this.size = 0;
  }
  contains(e) {
    const n = this.sparse[e];
    return n < this.size && this.densePcs[n] === e;
  }
  isEmpty() {
    return this.size === 0;
  }
  add(e) {
    const n = this.size++;
    return this.sparse[e] = n, this.denseThreads[n] = null, this.densePcs[n] = e, n;
  }
  clear() {
    this.sparse = [], this.densePcs = [], this.denseThreads = [], this.size = 0;
  }
  toString() {
    let e = "{";
    for (let n = 0; n < this.size; n++) n !== 0 && (e += ", "), e += this.densePcs[n];
    return e += "}", e;
  }
}
class UC {
  static fromRE2(e) {
    const n = new UC();
    return n.prog = e.prog, n.re2 = e, n.q0 = new VGe(n.prog.numInst()), n.q1 = new VGe(n.prog.numInst()), n.pool = [], n.poolSize = 0, n.matched = false, n.matchcap = Array(n.prog.numCap < 2 ? 2 : n.prog.numCap).fill(0), n.ncap = 0, n;
  }
  static fromMachine(e) {
    const n = new UC();
    return n.re2 = e.re2, n.prog = e.prog, n.q0 = e.q0, n.q1 = e.q1, n.pool = e.pool, n.poolSize = e.poolSize, n.matched = e.matched, n.matchcap = e.matchcap, n.ncap = e.ncap, n;
  }
  init(e) {
    this.ncap = e, e > this.matchcap.length ? this.initNewCap(e) : this.resetCap(e);
  }
  resetCap(e) {
    for (let n = 0; n < this.poolSize; n++) {
      const r = this.pool[n];
      r.cap = Array(e).fill(0);
    }
  }
  initNewCap(e) {
    for (let n = 0; n < this.poolSize; n++) {
      const r = this.pool[n];
      r.cap = Array(e).fill(0);
    }
    this.matchcap = Array(e).fill(0);
  }
  submatches() {
    return this.ncap === 0 ? Ss.emptyInts() : this.matchcap.slice(0, this.ncap);
  }
  alloc(e) {
    let n;
    return this.poolSize > 0 ? (this.poolSize--, n = this.pool[this.poolSize]) : n = new Eqn(), n.inst = e, n;
  }
  freeQueue(e, n = 0) {
    const r = e.size - n, i = this.poolSize + r;
    this.pool.length < i && (this.pool = this.pool.slice(0, Math.max(this.pool.length * 2, i)));
    for (let s = n; s < e.size; s++) {
      const o = e.denseThreads[s];
      o !== null && (this.pool[this.poolSize] = o, this.poolSize++);
    }
    e.clear();
  }
  freeThread(e) {
    this.pool.length <= this.poolSize && (this.pool = this.pool.slice(0, this.pool.length * 2)), this.pool[this.poolSize] = e, this.poolSize++;
  }
  match(e, n, r) {
    const i = this.re2.cond;
    if (i === Ss.EMPTY_ALL || (r === zn.ANCHOR_START || r === zn.ANCHOR_BOTH) && n !== 0) return false;
    this.matched = false, this.matchcap = Array(this.prog.numCap).fill(-1);
    let s = this.q0, o = this.q1, a = e.step(n), l = a >> 3, c = a & 7, h = -1, u = 0;
    a !== sv.EOF() && (a = e.step(n + c), h = a >> 3, u = a & 7);
    let d;
    for (n === 0 ? d = Ss.emptyOpContext(-1, l) : d = e.context(n); ; ) {
      if (s.isEmpty()) {
        if ((i & Ss.EMPTY_BEGIN_TEXT) !== 0 && n !== 0 || this.matched) break;
        if (this.re2.prefix.length !== 0 && h !== this.re2.prefixRune && e.canCheckPrefix()) {
          const m = e.index(this.re2, n);
          if (m < 0) break;
          n += m, a = e.step(n), l = a >> 3, c = a & 7, a = e.step(n + c), h = a >> 3, u = a & 7;
        }
      }
      !this.matched && (n === 0 || r === zn.UNANCHORED) && (this.ncap > 0 && (this.matchcap[0] = n), this.add(s, this.prog.start, n, this.matchcap, d, null));
      const f = n + c;
      if (d = e.context(f), this.step(s, o, n, f, l, d, r, n === e.endPos()), c === 0 || this.ncap === 0 && this.matched) break;
      n += c, l = h, c = u, l !== -1 && (a = e.step(n + c), h = a >> 3, u = a & 7);
      const p = s;
      s = o, o = p;
    }
    return this.freeQueue(o), this.matched;
  }
  step(e, n, r, i, s, o, a, l) {
    const c = this.re2.longest;
    for (let h = 0; h < e.size; h++) {
      let u = e.denseThreads[h];
      if (u === null) continue;
      if (c && this.matched && this.ncap > 0 && this.matchcap[0] < u.cap[0]) {
        this.freeThread(u);
        continue;
      }
      const d = u.inst;
      let f = false;
      switch (d.op) {
        case Dr.MATCH:
          if (a === zn.ANCHOR_BOTH && !l) break;
          this.ncap > 0 && (!c || !this.matched || this.matchcap[1] < r) && (u.cap[1] = r, this.matchcap = u.cap.slice(0, this.ncap)), c || this.freeQueue(e, h + 1), this.matched = true;
          break;
        case Dr.RUNE:
          f = d.matchRune(s);
          break;
        case Dr.RUNE1:
          f = s === d.runes[0];
          break;
        case Dr.RUNE_ANY:
          f = true;
          break;
        case Dr.RUNE_ANY_NOT_NL:
          f = s !== Jt.CODES.get(`
`);
          break;
        default:
          throw new Error("bad inst");
      }
      f && (u = this.add(n, d.out, i, u.cap, o, u)), u !== null && (this.freeThread(u), e.denseThreads[h] = null);
    }
    e.clear();
  }
  add(e, n, r, i, s, o) {
    if (n === 0 || e.contains(n)) return o;
    const a = e.add(n), l = this.prog.inst[n];
    switch (l.op) {
      case Dr.FAIL:
        break;
      case Dr.ALT:
      case Dr.ALT_MATCH:
        o = this.add(e, l.out, r, i, s, o), o = this.add(e, l.arg, r, i, s, o);
        break;
      case Dr.EMPTY_WIDTH:
        (l.arg & ~s) === 0 && (o = this.add(e, l.out, r, i, s, o));
        break;
      case Dr.NOP:
        o = this.add(e, l.out, r, i, s, o);
        break;
      case Dr.CAPTURE:
        if (l.arg < this.ncap) {
          const c = i[l.arg];
          i[l.arg] = r, this.add(e, l.out, r, i, s, null), i[l.arg] = c;
        } else o = this.add(e, l.out, r, i, s, o);
        break;
      case Dr.MATCH:
      case Dr.RUNE:
      case Dr.RUNE1:
      case Dr.RUNE_ANY:
      case Dr.RUNE_ANY_NOT_NL:
        o === null ? o = this.alloc(l) : o.inst = l, this.ncap > 0 && o.cap !== i && (o.cap = i.slice(0, this.ncap)), e.denseThreads[a] = o, o = null;
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error("unhandled");
    }
    return o;
  }
}
class It {
  static Op = x_t(["NO_MATCH", "EMPTY_MATCH", "LITERAL", "CHAR_CLASS", "ANY_CHAR_NOT_NL", "ANY_CHAR", "BEGIN_LINE", "END_LINE", "BEGIN_TEXT", "END_TEXT", "WORD_BOUNDARY", "NO_WORD_BOUNDARY", "CAPTURE", "STAR", "PLUS", "QUEST", "REPEAT", "CONCAT", "ALTERNATE", "LEFT_PAREN", "VERTICAL_BAR"]);
  static isPseudoOp(e) {
    return e >= It.Op.LEFT_PAREN;
  }
  static emptySubs() {
    return [];
  }
  static quoteIfHyphen(e) {
    return e === Jt.CODES.get("-") ? "\\" : "";
  }
  static fromRegexp(e) {
    const n = new It(e.op);
    return n.flags = e.flags, n.subs = e.subs, n.runes = e.runes, n.cap = e.cap, n.min = e.min, n.max = e.max, n.name = e.name, n.namedGroups = e.namedGroups, n;
  }
  constructor(e) {
    this.op = e, this.flags = 0, this.subs = It.emptySubs(), this.runes = [], this.min = 0, this.max = 0, this.cap = 0, this.name = null, this.namedGroups = {};
  }
  reinit() {
    this.flags = 0, this.subs = It.emptySubs(), this.runes = [], this.cap = 0, this.min = 0, this.max = 0, this.name = null, this.namedGroups = {};
  }
  toString() {
    return this.appendTo();
  }
  appendTo() {
    let e = "";
    switch (this.op) {
      case It.Op.NO_MATCH:
        e += "[^\\x00-\\x{10FFFF}]";
        break;
      case It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH:
        e += "(?:)";
        break;
      case It.Op.STAR:
      case It.Op.PLUS:
      case It.Op.QUEST:
      case It.Op.REPEAT: {
        const n = this.subs[0];
        switch (n.op > It.Op.CAPTURE || n.op === It.Op.LITERAL && n.runes.length > 1 ? e += `(?:${n.appendTo()})` : e += n.appendTo(), this.op) {
          case It.Op.STAR:
            e += "*";
            break;
          case It.Op.PLUS:
            e += "+";
            break;
          case It.Op.QUEST:
            e += "?";
            break;
          case It.Op.REPEAT:
            e += `{${this.min}`, this.min !== this.max && (e += ",", this.max >= 0 && (e += this.max)), e += "}";
            break;
        }
        (this.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== 0 && (e += "?");
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.CONCAT: {
        for (let n of this.subs) n.op === It.Op.ALTERNATE ? e += `(?:${n.appendTo()})` : e += n.appendTo();
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.ALTERNATE: {
        let n = "";
        for (let r of this.subs) e += n, n = "|", e += r.appendTo();
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.LITERAL:
        (this.flags & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== 0 && (e += "(?i:");
        for (let n of this.runes) e += Ss.escapeRune(n);
        (this.flags & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== 0 && (e += ")");
        break;
      case It.Op.ANY_CHAR_NOT_NL:
        e += "(?-s:.)";
        break;
      case It.Op.ANY_CHAR:
        e += "(?s:.)";
        break;
      case It.Op.CAPTURE:
        this.name === null || this.name.length === 0 ? e += "(" : e += `(?P<${this.name}>`, this.subs[0].op !== It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH && (e += this.subs[0].appendTo()), e += ")";
        break;
      case It.Op.BEGIN_TEXT:
        e += "\\A";
        break;
      case It.Op.END_TEXT:
        (this.flags & zn.WAS_DOLLAR) !== 0 ? e += "(?-m:$)" : e += "\\z";
        break;
      case It.Op.BEGIN_LINE:
        e += "^";
        break;
      case It.Op.END_LINE:
        e += "$";
        break;
      case It.Op.WORD_BOUNDARY:
        e += "\\b";
        break;
      case It.Op.NO_WORD_BOUNDARY:
        e += "\\B";
        break;
      case It.Op.CHAR_CLASS:
        if (this.runes.length % 2 !== 0) {
          e += "[invalid char class]";
          break;
        }
        if (e += "[", this.runes.length === 0) e += "^\\x00-\\x{10FFFF}";
        else if (this.runes[0] === 0 && this.runes[this.runes.length - 1] === xi.MAX_RUNE) {
          e += "^";
          for (let n = 1; n < this.runes.length - 1; n += 2) {
            const r = this.runes[n] + 1, i = this.runes[n + 1] - 1;
            e += It.quoteIfHyphen(r), e += Ss.escapeRune(r), r !== i && (e += "-", e += It.quoteIfHyphen(i), e += Ss.escapeRune(i));
          }
        } else for (let n = 0; n < this.runes.length; n += 2) {
          const r = this.runes[n], i = this.runes[n + 1];
          e += It.quoteIfHyphen(r), e += Ss.escapeRune(r), r !== i && (e += "-", e += It.quoteIfHyphen(i), e += Ss.escapeRune(i));
        }
        e += "]";
        break;
      default:
        e += this.op;
        break;
    }
    return e;
  }
  maxCap() {
    let e = 0;
    if (this.op === It.Op.CAPTURE && (e = this.cap), this.subs !== null) for (let n of this.subs) {
      const r = n.maxCap();
      e < r && (e = r);
    }
    return e;
  }
  equals(e) {
    if (!(e !== null && e instanceof It) || this.op !== e.op) return false;
    switch (this.op) {
      case It.Op.END_TEXT: {
        if ((this.flags & zn.WAS_DOLLAR) !== (e.flags & zn.WAS_DOLLAR)) return false;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.LITERAL:
      case It.Op.CHAR_CLASS: {
        if (this.runes === null && e.runes === null) break;
        if (this.runes === null || e.runes === null || this.runes.length !== e.runes.length) return false;
        for (let n = 0; n < this.runes.length; n++) if (this.runes[n] !== e.runes[n]) return false;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.ALTERNATE:
      case It.Op.CONCAT: {
        if (this.subs.length !== e.subs.length) return false;
        for (let n = 0; n < this.subs.length; ++n) if (!this.subs[n].equals(e.subs[n])) return false;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.STAR:
      case It.Op.PLUS:
      case It.Op.QUEST: {
        if ((this.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== (e.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) || !this.subs[0].equals(e.subs[0])) return false;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.REPEAT: {
        if ((this.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== (e.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) || this.min !== e.min || this.max !== e.max || !this.subs[0].equals(e.subs[0])) return false;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.CAPTURE: {
        if (this.cap !== e.cap || (this.name === null ? e.name !== null : this.name !== e.name) || !this.subs[0].equals(e.subs[0])) return false;
        break;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}
class Aqn {
  constructor() {
    this.inst = [], this.start = 0, this.numCap = 2;
  }
  getInst(e) {
    return this.inst[e];
  }
  numInst() {
    return this.inst.length;
  }
  addInst(e) {
    this.inst.push(new Dr(e));
  }
  skipNop(e) {
    let n = this.inst[e];
    for (; n.op === Dr.NOP || n.op === Dr.CAPTURE; ) n = this.inst[e], e = n.out;
    return n;
  }
  prefix() {
    let e = "", n = this.skipNop(this.start);
    if (!Dr.isRuneOp(n.op) || n.runes.length !== 1) return [n.op === Dr.MATCH, e];
    for (; Dr.isRuneOp(n.op) && n.runes.length === 1 && (n.arg & zn.FOLD_CASE) === 0; ) e += String.fromCodePoint(n.runes[0]), n = this.skipNop(n.out);
    return [n.op === Dr.MATCH, e];
  }
  startCond() {
    let e = 0, n = this.start;
    e: for (; ; ) {
      const r = this.inst[n];
      switch (r.op) {
        case Dr.EMPTY_WIDTH:
          e |= r.arg;
          break;
        case Dr.FAIL:
          return -1;
        case Dr.CAPTURE:
        case Dr.NOP:
          break;
        default:
          break e;
      }
      n = r.out;
    }
    return e;
  }
  next(e) {
    const n = this.inst[e >> 1];
    return (e & 1) === 0 ? n.out : n.arg;
  }
  patch(e, n) {
    for (; e !== 0; ) {
      const r = this.inst[e >> 1];
      (e & 1) === 0 ? (e = r.out, r.out = n) : (e = r.arg, r.arg = n);
    }
  }
  append(e, n) {
    if (e === 0) return n;
    if (n === 0) return e;
    let r = e;
    for (; ; ) {
      const s = this.next(r);
      if (s === 0) break;
      r = s;
    }
    const i = this.inst[r >> 1];
    return (r & 1) === 0 ? i.out = n : i.arg = n, e;
  }
  toString() {
    let e = "";
    for (let n = 0; n < this.inst.length; n++) {
      const r = e.length;
      e += n, n === this.start && (e += "*"), e += "        ".substring(e.length - r), e += this.inst[n], e += `
`;
    }
    return e;
  }
}
class Iz {
  constructor(e = 0, n = 0, r = false) {
    this.i = e, this.out = n, this.nullable = r;
  }
}
class iN {
  static ANY_RUNE_NOT_NL() {
    return [0, Jt.CODES.get(`
`) - 1, Jt.CODES.get(`
`) + 1, xi.MAX_RUNE];
  }
  static ANY_RUNE() {
    return [0, xi.MAX_RUNE];
  }
  static compileRegexp(e) {
    const n = new iN(), r = n.compile(e);
    return n.prog.patch(r.out, n.newInst(Dr.MATCH).i), n.prog.start = r.i, n.prog;
  }
  constructor() {
    this.prog = new Aqn(), this.newInst(Dr.FAIL);
  }
  newInst(e) {
    return this.prog.addInst(e), new Iz(this.prog.numInst() - 1, 0, true);
  }
  nop() {
    const e = this.newInst(Dr.NOP);

  compile(e) {
    switch (e.op) {
      case It.Op.NO_MATCH:
        return this.fail();
      case It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH:
        return this.nop();

      case It.Op.BEGIN_LINE:

      case It.Op.END_LINE:

      case It.Op.BEGIN_TEXT:

      case It.Op.END_TEXT:
        return this.empty(Ss.EMPTY_END_TEXT);
      case It.Op.WORD_BOUNDARY:

      case It.Op.NO_WORD_BOUNDARY:
        return this.empty(Ss.EMPTY_NO_WORD_BOUNDARY);
      case It.Op.CAPTURE: {

        return this.cat(this.cat(n, r), i);
      }
      case It.Op.STAR:
        return this.star(this.compile(e.subs[0]), (e.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== 0);
      case It.Op.PLUS:
        return this.plus(this.compile(e.subs[0]), (e.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== 0);
      case It.Op.QUEST:
        return this.quest(this.compile(e.subs[0]), (e.flags & zn.NON_GREEDY) !== 0);
      case It.Op.CONCAT: {

          for (let r of e.subs) {
            const i = this.compile(r);
            n = n === null ? i : this.cat(n, i);
          }
          return n;
        }
      }
      case It.Op.ALTERNATE: {

          for (let r of e.subs) {

          }

        }

  }

      case Jt.CODES.get("4"):
      case Jt.CODES.get("5"):
      case Jt.CODES.get("6"):
      case Jt.CODES.get("7"):
        if (!e.more() || e.peek() < Jt.CODES.get("0") || e.peek() > Jt.CODES.get("7")) break;
      case Jt.CODES.get("0"): {
        let i = r - Jt.CODES.get("0");
        for (let s = 1; s < 3 && !(!e.more() || e.peek() < Jt.CODES.get("0") || e.peek() > Jt.CODES.get("7")); s++) i = i * 8 + e.peek() - Jt.CODES.get("0"), e.skip(1);
        return i;
      }
      case Jt.CODES.get("x"): {
        if (!e.more()) break;
        if (r = e.pop(), r === Jt.CODES.get("{")) {
          let o = 0, a = 0;
          for (; ; ) {
            if (!e.more()) break e;
            if (r = e.pop(), r === Jt.CODES.get("}")) break;
            const l = Ss.unhex(r);
            if (l < 0 || (a = a * 16 + l, a > xi.MAX_RUNE)) break e;
            o++;
          }
          if (o === 0) break e;
          return a;
        }
        const i = Ss.unhex(r);
        if (!e.more()) break;
        r = e.pop();
        const s = Ss.unhex(r);
        if (i < 0 || s < 0) break;
        return i * 16 + s;
      }
      case Jt.CODES.get("a"):
        return Jt.CODES.get("\x07");
      case Jt.CODES.get("f"):
        return Jt.CODES.get("\f");
      case Jt.CODES.get("n"):
        return Jt.CODES.get(`
`);
      case Jt.CODES.get("r"):
        return Jt.CODES.get("\r");
      case Jt.CODES.get("t"):
        return Jt.CODES.get("	");
      case Jt.CODES.get("v"):
        return Jt.CODES.get("\v");
      default:
        if (r <= xi.MAX_ASCII && !Ss.isalnum(r)) return r;
        break;
    }
    throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_ESCAPE, e.from(n));
  }
  static parseClassChar(e, n) {
    if (!e.more()) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_MISSING_BRACKET, e.from(n));
    return e.lookingAt("\\") ? Cr.parseEscape(e) : e.pop();
  }
  static concatRunes(e, n) {
    return [...e, ...n];
  }
  constructor(e, n = 0) {
    this.wholeRegexp = e, this.flags = n, this.numCap = 0, this.namedGroups = {}, this.stack = [], this.free = null, this.numRegexp = 0, this.numRunes = 0, this.repeats = 0, this.height = null, this.size = null;
  }
  newRegexp(e) {
    let n = this.free;
    return n !== null && n.subs !== null && n.subs.length > 0 ? (this.free = n.subs[0], n.reinit(), n.op = e) : (n = new It(e), this.numRegexp += 1), n;
  }
  reuse(e) {
    this.height !== null && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.height, e) && delete this.height[e], e.subs !== null && e.subs.length > 0 && (e.subs[0] = this.free), this.free = e;
  }
  checkLimits(e) {
    if (this.numRunes > Cr.MAX_RUNES) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_LARGE);
    this.checkSize(e), this.checkHeight(e);
  }
  checkSize(e) {
    if (this.size === null) {
      if (this.repeats === 0 && (this.repeats = 1), e.op === It.Op.REPEAT) {
        let n = e.max;
        n === -1 && (n = e.min), n <= 0 && (n = 1), n > Cr.MAX_SIZE / this.repeats ? this.repeats = Cr.MAX_SIZE : this.repeats *= n;
      }
      if (this.numRegexp < Cr.MAX_SIZE / this.repeats) return;
      this.size = {};
      for (let n of this.stack) this.checkSize(n);
    }
    if (this.calcSize(e, true) > Cr.MAX_SIZE) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_LARGE);
  }
  calcSize(e, n = false) {
    if (!n && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.size, e)) return this.size[e];
    let r = 0;
    switch (e.op) {
      case It.Op.LITERAL: {
        r = e.runes.length;
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.CAPTURE:
      case It.Op.STAR: {
        r = 2 + this.calcSize(e.subs[0]);
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.PLUS:
      case It.Op.QUEST: {
        r = 1 + this.calcSize(e.subs[0]);
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.CONCAT: {
        for (let i of e.subs) r = r + this.calcSize(i);
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.ALTERNATE: {
        for (let i of e.subs) r = r + this.calcSize(i);
        e.subs.length > 1 && (r = r + e.subs.length - 1);
        break;
      }
      case It.Op.REPEAT: {
        let i = this.calcSize(e.subs[0]);
        if (e.max === -1) {
          e.min === 0 ? r = 2 + i : r = 1 + e.min * i;
          break;
        }
        r = e.max * i + (e.max - e.min);
        break;
      }
    }
    return r = Math.max(1, r), this.size[e] = r, r;
  }
  checkHeight(e) {
    if (!(this.numRegexp < Cr.MAX_HEIGHT)) {
      if (this.height === null) {
        this.height = {};
        for (let n of this.stack) this.checkHeight(n);
      }
      if (this.calcHeight(e, true) > Cr.MAX_HEIGHT) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_NESTING_DEPTH);
    }
  }
  calcHeight(e, n = false) {
    if (!n && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.height, e)) return this.height[e];
    let r = 1;
    for (let i of e.subs) {
      const s = this.calcHeight(i);
      r < 1 + s && (r = 1 + s);
    }
    return this.height[e] = r, r;
  }
  pop() {
    return this.stack.pop();
  }
  popToPseudo() {
    const e = this.stack.length;
    let n = e;
    for (; n > 0 && !It.isPseudoOp(this.stack[n - 1].op); ) n--;
    const r = this.stack.slice(n, e);
    return this.stack = this.stack.slice(0, n), r;
  }
  push(e) {
    if (this.numRunes += e.runes.length, e.op === It.Op.CHAR_CLASS && e.runes.length === 2 && e.runes[0] === e.runes[1]) {
      if (this.maybeConcat(e.runes[0], this.flags & -2)) return null;
      e.op = It.Op.LITERAL, e.runes = [e.runes[0]], e.flags = this.flags & -2;
    } else if (e.op === It.Op.CHAR_CLASS && e.runes.length === 4 && e.runes[0] === e.runes[1] && e.runes[2] === e.runes[3] && xi.simpleFold(e.runes[0]) === e.runes[2] && xi.simpleFold(e.runes[2]) === e.runes[0] || e.op === It.Op.CHAR_CLASS && e.runes.length === 2 && e.runes[0] + 1 === e.runes[1] && xi.simpleFold(e.runes[0]) === e.runes[1] && xi.simpleFold(e.runes[1]) === e.runes[0]) {
      if (this.maybeConcat(e.runes[0], this.flags | zn.FOLD_CASE)) return null;
      e.op = It.Op.LITERAL, e.runes = [e.runes[0]], e.flags = this.flags | zn.FOLD_CASE;
    } else this.maybeConcat(-1, 0);
    return this.stack.push(e), this.checkLimits(e), e;
  }
  maybeConcat(e, n) {
    const r = this.stack.length;
    if (r < 2) return false;
    const i = this.stack[r - 1], s = this.stack[r - 2];
    return i.op !== It.Op.LITERAL || s.op !== It.Op.LITERAL || (i.flags & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== (s.flags & zn.FOLD_CASE) ? false : (s.runes = Cr.concatRunes(s.runes, i.runes), e >= 0 ? (i.runes = [e], i.flags = n, true) : (this.pop(), this.reuse(i), false));
  }
  newLiteral(e, n) {
    const r = this.newRegexp(It.Op.LITERAL);
    return r.flags = n, (n & zn.FOLD_CASE) !== 0 && (e = Cr.minFoldRune(e)), r.runes = [e], r;
  }
  literal(e) {
    this.push(this.newLiteral(e, this.flags));
  }
  op(e) {
    const n = this.newRegexp(e);
    return n.flags = this.flags, this.push(n);
  }
  repeat(e, n, r, i, s, o) {
    let a = this.flags;
    if ((a & zn.PERL_X) !== 0 && (s.more() && s.lookingAt("?") && (s.skip(1), a ^= zn.NON_GREEDY), o !== -1)) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_REPEAT_OP, s.from(o));
    const l = this.stack.length;
    if (l === 0) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_MISSING_REPEAT_ARGUMENT, s.from(i));
    const c = this.stack[l - 1];
    if (It.isPseudoOp(c.op)) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_MISSING_REPEAT_ARGUMENT, s.from(i));
    const h = this.newRegexp(e);
    if (h.min = n, h.max = r, h.flags = a, h.subs = [c], this.stack[l - 1] = h, this.checkLimits(h), e === It.Op.REPEAT && (n >= 2 || r >= 2) && !this.repeatIsValid(h, 1e3)) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_REPEAT_SIZE, s.from(i));
  }
  repeatIsValid(e, n) {
    if (e.op === It.Op.REPEAT) {
      let r = e.max;
      if (r === 0) return true;
      if (r < 0 && (r = e.min), r > n) return false;
      r > 0 && (n = Math.trunc(n / r));
    }
    for (let r of e.subs) if (!this.repeatIsValid(r, n)) return false;
    return true;
  }
  concat() {
    this.maybeConcat(-1, 0);
    const e = this.popToPseudo();
    return e.length === 0 ? this.push(this.newRegexp(It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH)) : this.push(this.collapse(e, It.Op.CONCAT));
  }
  alternate() {
    const e = this.popToPseudo();
    return e.length > 0 && this.cleanAlt(e[e.length - 1]), e.length === 0 ? this.push(this.newRegexp(It.Op.NO_MATCH)) : this.push(this.collapse(e, It.Op.ALTERNATE));
  }
  cleanAlt(e) {
    e.op === It.Op.CHAR_CLASS && (e.runes = new xu(e.runes).cleanClass().toArray(), e.runes.length === 2 && e.runes[0] === 0 && e.runes[1] === xi.MAX_RUNE ? (e.runes = [], e.op = It.Op.ANY_CHAR) : e.runes.length === 4 && e.runes[0] === 0 && e.runes[1] === Jt.CODES.get(`
`) - 1 && e.runes[2] === Jt.CODES.get(`
`) + 1 && e.runes[3] === xi.MAX_RUNE && (e.runes = [], e.op = It.Op.ANY_CHAR_NOT_NL));
  }
  collapse(e, n) {
    if (e.length === 1) return e[0];
    let r = 0;
    for (let a of e) r += a.op === n ? a.subs.length : 1;
    let i = new Array(r).fill(null), s = 0;
    for (let a of e) a.op === n ? (i.splice(s, a.subs.length, ...a.subs), s += a.subs.length, this.reuse(a)) : i[s++] = a;
    let o = this.newRegexp(n);
    if (o.subs = i, n === It.Op.ALTERNATE && (o.subs = this.factor(o.subs), o.subs.length === 1)) {
      const a = o;
      o = o.subs[0], this.reuse(a);
    }
    return o;
  }
  factor(e) {
    if (e.length < 2) return e;
    let n = 0, r = e.length, i = 0, s = null, o = 0, a = 0, l = 0;
    for (let h = 0; h <= r; h++) {
      let u = null, d = 0, f = 0;
      if (h < r) {
        let p = e[n + h];
        if (p.op === It.Op.CONCAT && p.subs.length > 0 && (p = p.subs[0]), p.op === It.Op.LITERAL && (u = p.runes, d = p.runes.length, f = p.flags & zn.FOLD_CASE), f === a) {
          let m = 0;
          for (; m < o && m < d && s[m] === u[m]; ) m++;
          if (m > 0) {
            o = m;
            continue;
          }
        }
      }
      if (h !== l) if (h === l + 1) e[i++] = e[n + l];
      else {
        const p = this.newRegexp(It.Op.LITERAL);
        p.flags = a, p.runes = s.slice(0, o);
        for (let y = l; y < h; y++) e[n + y] = this.removeLeadingString(e[n + y], o), this.checkLimits(e[n + y]);
        const m = this.collapse(e.slice(n + l, n + h), It.Op.ALTERNATE), g = this.newRegexp(It.Op.CONCAT);
        g.subs = [p, m], e[i++] = g;
      }
      l = h, s = u, o = d, a = f;
    }
    r = i, n = 0, l = 0, i = 0;
    let c = null;
    for (let h = 0; h <= r; h++) {
      let u = null;
      if (!(h < r && (u = Cr.leadingRegexp(e[n + h]), c !== null && c.equals(u) && (Cr.isCharClass(c) || c.op === It.Op.REPEAT && c.min === c.max && Cr.isCharClass(c.subs[0]))))) {
        if (h !== l) if (h === l + 1) e[i++] = e[n + l];
        else {
          const d = c;
          for (let m = l; m < h; m++) {
            const g = m !== l;
            e[n + m] = this.removeLeadingRegexp(e[n + m], g), this.checkLimits(e[n + m]);
          }
          const f = this.collapse(e.slice(n + l, n + h), It.Op.ALTERNATE), p = this.newRegexp(It.Op.CONCAT);
          p.subs = [d, f], e[i++] = p;
        }
        l = h, c = u;
      }
    }
    r = i, n = 0, l = 0, i = 0;
    for (let h = 0; h <= r; h++) if (!(h < r && Cr.isCharClass(e[n + h]))) {
      if (h !== l) if (h === l + 1) e[i++] = e[n + l];
      else {
        let u = l;
        for (let f = l + 1; f < h; f++) {
          const p = e[n + u], m = e[n + f];
          (p.op < m.op || p.op === m.op && (p.runes !== null ? p.runes.length : 0) < (m.runes !== null ? m.runes.length : 0)) && (u = f);
        }
        const d = e[n + l];
        e[n + l] = e[n + u], e[n + u] = d;
        for (let f = l + 1; f < h; f++) Cr.mergeCharClass(e[n + l], e[n + f]), this.reuse(e[n + f]);
        this.cleanAlt(e[n + l]), e[i++] = e[n + l];
      }
      h < r && (e[i++] = e[n + h]), l = h + 1;
    }
    r = i, n = 0, l = 0, i = 0;
    for (let h = 0; h < r; ++h) h + 1 < r && e[n + h].op === It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH && e[n + h + 1].op === It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH || (e[i++] = e[n + h]);
    return r = i, n = 0, e.slice(n, r);
  }
  removeLeadingString(e, n) {
    if (e.op === It.Op.CONCAT && e.subs.length > 0) {
      const r = this.removeLeadingString(e.subs[0], n);
      if (e.subs[0] = r, r.op === It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH) switch (this.reuse(r), e.subs.length) {
        case 0:
        case 1:
          e.op = It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH, e.subs = null;
          break;
        case 2: {
          const i = e;
          e = e.subs[1], this.reuse(i);
          break;
        }
        default:
          e.subs = e.subs.slice(1, e.subs.length);
          break;
      }
      return e;
    }
    return e.op === It.Op.LITERAL && (e.runes = e.runes.slice(n, e.runes.length), e.runes.length === 0 && (e.op = It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH)), e;
  }
  removeLeadingRegexp(e, n) {
    if (e.op === It.Op.CONCAT && e.subs.length > 0) {
      switch (n && this.reuse(e.subs[0]), e.subs = e.subs.slice(1, e.subs.length), e.subs.length) {
        case 0: {
          e.op = It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH, e.subs = It.emptySubs();
          break;
        }
        case 1: {
          const r = e;
          e = e.subs[0], this.reuse(r);
          break;
        }
      }
      return e;
    }
    return n && this.reuse(e), this.newRegexp(It.Op.EMPTY_MATCH);
  }
  parseInternal() {
    if ((this.flags & zn.LITERAL) !== 0) return Cr.literalRegexp(this.wholeRegexp, this.flags);
    let e = -1, n = -1, r = -1;
    const i = new Tqn(this.wholeRegexp);
    for (; i.more(); ) {
      let o = -1;
      e: switch (i.peek()) {
        case Jt.CODES.get("("):
          if ((this.flags & zn.PERL_X) !== 0 && i.lookingAt("(?")) {
            this.parsePerlFlags(i);
            break;
          }
          this.op(It.Op.LEFT_PAREN).cap = ++this.numCap, i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("|"):
          this.parseVerticalBar(), i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get(")"):
          this.parseRightParen(), i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("^"):
          (this.flags & zn.ONE_LINE) !== 0 ? this.op(It.Op.BEGIN_TEXT) : this.op(It.Op.BEGIN_LINE), i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("$"):
          (this.flags & zn.ONE_LINE) !== 0 ? this.op(It.Op.END_TEXT).flags |= zn.WAS_DOLLAR : this.op(It.Op.END_LINE), i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("."):
          (this.flags & zn.DOT_NL) !== 0 ? this.op(It.Op.ANY_CHAR) : this.op(It.Op.ANY_CHAR_NOT_NL), i.skip(1);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("["):
          this.parseClass(i);
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("*"):
        case Jt.CODES.get("+"):
        case Jt.CODES.get("?"): {
          o = i.pos();
          let a = null;
          switch (i.pop()) {
            case Jt.CODES.get("*"):
              a = It.Op.STAR;
              break;
            case Jt.CODES.get("+"):
              a = It.Op.PLUS;
              break;
            case Jt.CODES.get("?"):
              a = It.Op.QUEST;
              break;
          }
          this.repeat(a, n, r, o, i, e);
          break;
        }
        case Jt.CODES.get("{"): {
          o = i.pos();
          const a = Cr.parseRepeat(i);
          if (a < 0) {
            i.rewindTo(o), this.literal(i.pop());
            break;
          }
          n = a >> 16, r = (a & xi.MAX_BMP) << 16 >> 16, this.repeat(It.Op.REPEAT, n, r, o, i, e);
          break;
        }
        case Jt.CODES.get("\\"): {
          const a = i.pos();
          if (i.skip(1), (this.flags & zn.PERL_X) !== 0 && i.more()) switch (i.pop()) {
            case Jt.CODES.get("A"):
              this.op(It.Op.BEGIN_TEXT);
              break e;
            case Jt.CODES.get("b"):
              this.op(It.Op.WORD_BOUNDARY);
              break e;
            case Jt.CODES.get("B"):
              this.op(It.Op.NO_WORD_BOUNDARY);
              break e;
            case Jt.CODES.get("C"):
              throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_ESCAPE, "\\C");
            case Jt.CODES.get("Q"): {
              let u = i.rest();
              const d = u.indexOf("\\E");
              d >= 0 && (u = u.substring(0, d)), i.skipString(u), i.skipString("\\E");
              let f = 0;
              for (; f < u.length; ) {
                const p = u.codePointAt(f);
                this.literal(p), f += Ss.charCount(p);
              }
              break e;
            }
            case Jt.CODES.get("z"):
              this.op(It.Op.END_TEXT);
              break e;
            default:
              i.rewindTo(a);
              break;
          }
          const l = this.newRegexp(It.Op.CHAR_CLASS);
          if (l.flags = this.flags, i.lookingAt("\\p") || i.lookingAt("\\P")) {
            const h = new xu();
            if (this.parseUnicodeClass(i, h)) {
              l.runes = h.toArray(), this.push(l);
              break e;
            }
          }
          const c = new xu();
          if (this.parsePerlClassEscape(i, c)) {
            l.runes = c.toArray(), this.push(l);
            break e;
          }
          i.rewindTo(a), this.reuse(l), this.literal(Cr.parseEscape(i));
          break;
        }
        default:
          this.literal(i.pop());
          break;
      }
      e = o;
    }
    if (this.concat(), this.swapVerticalBar() && this.pop(), this.alternate(), this.stack.length !== 1) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_MISSING_PAREN, this.wholeRegexp);
    return this.stack[0].namedGroups = this.namedGroups, this.stack[0];
  }
  parsePerlFlags(e) {
    const n = e.pos(), r = e.rest();
    if (r.startsWith("(?P<") || r.startsWith("(?<")) {
      const a = r.charAt(2) === "P" ? 4 : 3, l = r.indexOf(">");
      if (l < 0) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_NAMED_CAPTURE, r);
      const c = r.substring(a, l);
      if (e.skipString(c), e.skip(a + 1), !Cr.isValidCaptureName(c)) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_NAMED_CAPTURE, r.substring(0, l + 1));
      const h = this.op(It.Op.LEFT_PAREN);
      if (h.cap = ++this.numCap, this.namedGroups[c]) throw new Po(Cr.ERR_DUPLICATE_NAMED_CAPTURE, c);
      this.namedGroups[c] = this.numCap, h.name = c;
      return;
    }
    e.skip(2);
    let i = this.flags, s = 1, o = false;
    e: for (; e.more(); ) {
      const a = e.pop();
      switch (a) {
        case Jt.CODES.get("i"):
          i |= zn.FOLD_CASE, o = true;
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("m"):
          i &= -17, o = true;
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("s"):
          i |= zn.DOT_NL, o = true;
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("U"):
          i |= zn.NON_GREEDY, o = true;
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get("-"):
          if (s < 0) break e;
          s = -1, i = ~i, o = false;
          break;
        case Jt.CODES.get(":"):
        case Jt.CODES.get(")"):
          if (s < 0) {
            if (!o) break e;
            i = ~i;
          }
          a === Jt.CODES.get(":") && this.op(It.Op.LEFT_PAREN), this.flags = i;
          return;
        default:
          break e;
      }
    }
    throw new Po(Cr.ERR_INVALID_PERL_OP, e.from(n));
  }
  parseVerticalBar() {

class X6 {
  static isUpperCaseAlpha(e) {
    return "A" <= e && e <= "Z";
  }
  static isHexadecimal(e) {
    return "0" <= e && e <= "9" || "A" <= e && e <= "F" || "a" <= e && e <= "f";
  }
  static getUtf8CharSize(e) {
    const n = e.charCodeAt(0);
    return n < 128 ? 1 : n < 2048 ? 2 : n < 65536 ? 3 : 4;
  }
  static translate(e) {
    if (typeof e != "string") return e;
    let n = "", r = false, i = e.length;
    i === 0 && (n = "(?:)", r = true);
    let s = 0;
    for (; s < i; ) {
      let o = e[s];
      if (o === "\\") {
        if (s + 1 < i) switch (o = e[s + 1], o) {
          case "\\": {
            n += "\\\\", s += 2;
            continue;
          }
          case "c": {
            if (s + 2 < i) {
              let l = e[s + 2];
              if (X6.isUpperCaseAlpha(l)) {
                n += "\\x", n += (l.charCodeAt(0) - 64 >> 4).toString(16).toUpperCase(), n += (l.charCodeAt(0) - 64 & 15).toString(16).toUpperCase(), s += 3, r = true;
                continue;
              }
            }
            n += "\\c", s += 2;
            continue;
          }
          case "u": {
            if (s + 2 < i) {
              let l = e[s + 2];
              if (X6.isHexadecimal(l)) {
                n += "\\x{" + l, s += 3;
                for (let c = 0; c < 3 && s < i && (l = e[s], !!X6.isHexadecimal(l)); ++s, ++c) n += l;
                n += "}", r = true;
                continue;
              } else if (l === "{") {
                n += "\\x", s += 2, r = true;
                continue;
              }
            }
            n += "\\u", s += 2;
            continue;
          }
          default: {
            n += "\\";
            let l = X6.getUtf8CharSize(o);
            n += e.substring(s + 1, s + 1 + l), s += l + 1;
            continue;
          }
        }
      } else if (o === "/") {
        n += "\\/", s += 1, r = true;
        continue;
      } else if (o === "(" && s + 2 < i && e[s + 1] === "?" && e[s + 2] === "<" && (s + 3 >= i || e[s + 3] !== "=" && e[s + 3] !== "!")) {
        n += "(?P<", s += 3, r = true;
        continue;
      }
      let a = X6.getUtf8CharSize(o);
      n += e.substring(s, s + a), s += a;
    }
    return r ? n : e;
  }

== Reading transcripts ==

  tail -10 /agents/excel-abc/transcript.jsonl        # last 10 messages

  head -5 /agents/excel-abc/files/data.csv           # column names + a few rows

      }
    }
  }
  processEvent(e) {
    if (e.event_type === "connect" && e.payload) {
      const n = e.payload, r = YKe(n);
      e.disconnected || (this.connectedAgents.set(e.agent_id, r), this.config.onAgentOnline?.(e.agent_id, r), Lz(e.agent_id, { connected: true })), !e.replay && !e.disconnected && this.pushAgentConnectedReminder(e.agent_id, r), XKe(e.agent_id, r);
    }
    if (e.event_type === "status") {
      const n = e.payload;
      if (Lz(e.agent_id, n), n.fileName && !e.replay) {
        const i = this.connectedAgents.get(e.agent_id)?.label ?? e.agent_id;
        this.pushSystemReminder(`Agent "${i}" (id: ${e.agent_id}) is working on "${n.fileName}".`);
      }
    }
    if (e.event_type === "file" && e.payload) {
      const n = e.payload;
      n.filename && n.data && sCe(e.agent_id, { [n.filename]: n.data });
    }
    e.event_type === "disconnect" && (this.connectedAgents.delete(e.agent_id), this.config.onAgentOffline?.(e.agent_id), Vbe(e.agent_id), Lz(e.agent_id, { connected: false, disconnectedAt: e.timestamp }), e.replay || this.pushAgentOfflineReminder(e.agent_id)), this.config.onEvent?.(e);
  }
  pushAgentConnectedReminder(e, n) {
    this.systemReminders.push(`Agent "${n.label}" (id: ${e}) is connected.`);
  }
  pushAgentOnlineReminder(e, n) {
    this.systemReminders.push(`Agent "${n.label}" (id: ${e}) just connected.`);
  }
  pushAgentOfflineReminder(e) {
    this.systemReminders.push(`Agent "${e}" just disconnected.`);
  }
  async processIncomingQueue() {
    if (!this.isHandling) {
      for (this.isHandling = true; this.incomingQueue.length > 0; ) {
        const e = this.incomingQueue.shift();
        if (e) try {
          const n = this.config.messageHandler;
          n && await n(e.message, e.fromAgentId, e.files);
        } catch (n) {
          this.logger.error("Error in message handler", { fromAgentId: e.fromAgentId, error: n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n) });
        }
      }
      this.isHandling = false;
    }
  }
  send(e) {
    this.config.transport.send(e);
  }
}

function Jlr(t11, e, n) {
  let r = t11[e], i = t11[e].codePoints[0];
  if (n.glyphForCodePoint(i).advanceWidth === 0) return;
  let s = t11[e - 1].codePoints[0], o = Zlr(s);
  return t11.splice(e, 1), t11.splice(e - o, 0, r);
}

    t11.splice(o, 0, s), e++;
  }
  return e;
}

const Ucr = 32768, Bcr = 4095, $cr = 32768, ZJe = 16384, zcr = 8192, JJe = 4095, QJe = 128, eQe = 127, Hcr = 128, Wcr = 64, Vcr = 63;
class qcr {
  normalizeCoords(e) {
    let n = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < this.font.fvar.axis.length; r++) {
      let i = this.font.fvar.axis[r];
      e[r] < i.defaultValue ? n.push((e[r] - i.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON) / (i.defaultValue - i.minValue + Number.EPSILON)) : n.push((e[r] - i.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON) / (i.maxValue - i.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON));
    }
    if (this.font.avar) for (var r = 0; r < this.font.avar.segment.length; r++) {
      let s = this.font.avar.segment[r];
      for (let o = 0; o < s.correspondence.length; o++) {
        let a = s.correspondence[o];
        if (o >= 1 && n[r] < a.fromCoord) {
          let l = s.correspondence[o - 1];
          n[r] = ((n[r] - l.fromCoord) * (a.toCoord - l.toCoord) + Number.EPSILON) / (a.fromCoord - l.fromCoord + Number.EPSILON) + l.toCoord;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    return n;
  }
  transformPoints(e, n) {
    if (!this.font.fvar || !this.font.gvar) return;
    let { gvar: r } = this.font;
    if (e >= r.glyphCount) return;
    let i = r.offsets[e];
    if (i === r.offsets[e + 1]) return;
    let { stream: s } = this.font;
    if (s.pos = i, s.pos >= s.length) return;
    let o = s.readUInt16BE(), a = i + s.readUInt16BE();
    if (o & Ucr) {
      var l = s.pos;
      s.pos = a;
      var c = this.decodePoints();
      a = s.pos, s.pos = l;
    }
    let h = n.map((g) => g.copy());
    o &= Bcr;
    for (let g = 0; g < o; g++) {
      let y = s.readUInt16BE(), b = s.readUInt16BE();
      if (b & $cr) {
        var u = [];
        for (let R = 0; R < r.axisCount; R++) u.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384);
      } else {
        if ((b & JJe) >= r.globalCoordCount) throw new Error("Invalid gvar table");
        var u = r.globalCoords[b & JJe];
      }
      if (b & ZJe) {
        var d = [];
        for (let R = 0; R < r.axisCount; R++) d.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384);
        var f = [];
        for (let R = 0; R < r.axisCount; R++) f.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384);
      }
      let v = this.tupleFactor(b, u, d, f);
      if (v === 0) {
        a += y;
        continue;
      }
      var l = s.pos;
      if (s.pos = a, b & zcr) var p = this.decodePoints();
      else var p = c;
      let S = p.length === 0 ? n.length : p.length, C = this.decodeDeltas(S), T = this.decodeDeltas(S);
      if (p.length === 0) for (let R = 0; R < n.length; R++) {
        var m = n[R];
        m.x += Math.round(C[R] * v), m.y += Math.round(T[R] * v);
      }
      else {
        let R = h.map((P) => P.copy()), N = n.map(() => false);
        for (let P = 0; P < p.length; P++) {
          let B = p[P];
          if (B < n.length) {
            let U = R[B];
            N[B] = true, U.x += C[P] * v, U.y += T[P] * v;
          }
        }
        this.interpolateMissingDeltas(R, h, N);
        for (let P = 0; P < n.length; P++) {
          let B = R[P].x - h[P].x, U = R[P].y - h[P].y;
          n[P].x = Math.round(n[P].x + B), n[P].y = Math.round(n[P].y + U);
        }
      }
      a += y, s.pos = l;
    }
  }
  decodePoints() {
    let e = this.font.stream, n = e.readUInt8();
    n & QJe && (n = (n & eQe) << 8 | e.readUInt8());
    let r = new Uint16Array(n), i = 0, s = 0;
    for (; i < n; ) {
      let o = e.readUInt8(), a = (o & eQe) + 1, l = o & QJe ? e.readUInt16 : e.readUInt8;
      for (let c = 0; c < a && i < n; c++) s += l.call(e), r[i++] = s;
    }
    return r;
  }
  decodeDeltas(e) {
    let n = this.font.stream, r = 0, i = new Int16Array(e);
    for (; r < e; ) {
      let s = n.readUInt8(), o = (s & Vcr) + 1;
      if (s & Hcr) r += o;
      else {
        let a = s & Wcr ? n.readInt16BE : n.readInt8;
        for (let l = 0; l < o && r < e; l++) i[r++] = a.call(n);
      }
    }
    return i;
  }
  tupleFactor(e, n, r, i) {
    let s = this.normalizedCoords, { gvar: o } = this.font, a = 1;
    for (let l = 0; l < o.axisCount; l++) if (n[l] !== 0) {
      if (s[l] === 0) return 0;
      if ((e & ZJe) === 0) {
        if (s[l] < Math.min(0, n[l]) || s[l] > Math.max(0, n[l])) return 0;
        a = (a * s[l] + Number.EPSILON) / (n[l] + Number.EPSILON);
      } else {
        if (s[l] < r[l] || s[l] > i[l]) return 0;
        s[l] < n[l] ? a = a * (s[l] - r[l] + Number.EPSILON) / (n[l] - r[l] + Number.EPSILON) : a = a * (i[l] - s[l] + Number.EPSILON) / (i[l] - n[l] + Number.EPSILON);
      }
    }
    return a;
  }
  interpolateMissingDeltas(e, n, r) {
    if (e.length === 0) return;
    let i = 0;
    for (; i < e.length; ) {
      let s = i, o = i, a = e[o];
      for (; !a.endContour; ) a = e[++o];
      for (; i <= o && !r[i]; ) i++;
      if (i > o) continue;
      let l = i, c = i;
      for (i++; i <= o; ) r[i] && (this.deltaInterpolate(c + 1, i - 1, c, i, n, e), c = i), i++;
      c === l ? this.deltaShift(s, o, c, n, e) : (this.deltaInterpolate(c + 1, o, c, l, n, e), l > 0 && this.deltaInterpolate(s, l - 1, c, l, n, e)), i = o + 1;
    }
  }
  deltaInterpolate(e, n, r, i, s, o) {
    if (e > n) return;
    let a = ["x", "y"];
    for (let c = 0; c < a.length; c++) {
      let h = a[c];
      if (s[r][h] > s[i][h]) {
        var l = r;
